title: OSError In Blob.write When Running The Nightly Sync
body:
Environment

Lattice 3.2.1, Ubuntu 24.04 LTS, server ca-central-1.

Steps

To reproduce:
* With the log window open, start running the nightly sync.
* Run the app for a long session, then trigger the action.
* Watch the log for the traceback below.

Expected

No traceback; running the nightly sync normally takes a few seconds.

Actual

After a long session of several hours it starts failing. During a long session the open file count grows steadily.

Frequency

Reproduces on about half the runs.
stacktrace:
lattice/ui/main.py:46 in loop
lattice/sched/runner.py:128 in run_due
lattice/store/remote.py:76 in sync_all
lattice/store/blob.py:252 in write
OSError: [Errno 28] No space left on device
